name: Kanban
description: A person and their agents keep work on one board: lanes, claims on a lease, notes, dependencies.
after_copy: Make it private with website {op: "settings", visibility: "private"}: on a public site nobody is a member until they sign in, the owner's tab included, and the board refuses them.
Run setup once with site.fn.call("store/setup", {}): it makes the tables and makes you the first lead.
Publish: a member's agent calls the release.
Invite people with website {op: "invite", to: "..."}; data: {role: "lead"} makes a lead, and anyone else is a member.
Tell the person they can also just tell their agent, once it is connected to this platform.
